kpis.signal: Pompes et traitement utility-scale, segment historique, croissance organique modeste
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Water Infrastructure (pompes Flygt, traitement Wedeco/Leopold). Hausse 2023 reflète intégration Evoqua. Plus gros segment Xylem, marges en amélioration.
kpis.description_en: Water Infrastructure segment revenue (Flygt pumps, Wedeco/Leopold treatment). 2023 jump reflects Evoqua integration. Xylem's largest segment, expanding margins.

kpis.signal: Smart meters AMI : segment leader croissance + opportunite digitalisation utilities
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Measurement & Control Solutions (smart meters Sensus, network communication, analytics). Croissance la plus forte, porte la transition AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) utilities US/EU.
kpis.description_en: Measurement & Control Solutions revenue (Sensus smart meters, network communication, analytics). Fastest-growing segment, drives AMI transition for US/EU utilities.

kpis.signal: Segment ne aprs acquisition Evoqua (mai 2023), services + capital projects industriels
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Water Solutions and Services (ex-Evoqua). Cree par acquisition Evoqua mai 2023. Services maintenance + projets capital pour industriels. Plus haute proportion services recurrents du groupe.
kpis.description_en: Water Solutions and Services segment revenue (ex-Evoqua). Created by Evoqua acquisition May 2023. Maintenance services + capital projects for industrial clients. Highest recurring services mix in the group.

kpis.signal: Pompes batiment et industriel, cycle plus mature, exposition residentiel construction
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Applied Water (pompes Bell & Gossett, Goulds, Lowara). Marche batiment commercial + industriel + agriculture irrigation. Plus cyclique, croissance modeste sur 5 ans.
kpis.description_en: Applied Water segment revenue (Bell & Gossett, Goulds, Lowara pumps). Commercial buildings + industrial + agricultural irrigation. More cyclical, modest 5-year growth.

kpis.signal: Visibilite future ~6 mois CA, pic post-Evoqua, normalisation 2025
kpis.description_fr: Carnet de commandes total fin d annee. Pic 2023-2024 post-acquisition Evoqua + supply chain catchup. Normalisation 2025. Indicateur de visibilite revenus 6-12 mois.
kpis.description_en: Total ending backlog. Peaked 2023-2024 post-Evoqua + supply chain catchup. Normalizing 2025. Forward revenue visibility indicator 6-12 months.

kpis.signal: Restructuration accelere FY25 pour aligner WI post-integration Evoqua
kpis.description_fr: Couts de restructuration segment Water Infrastructure. Acceleration FY25 (+148%) pour realignement post-integration Evoqua + optimisation footprint manufacturing.
kpis.description_en: Water Infrastructure restructuring costs. FY25 acceleration (+148%) for post-Evoqua realignment + manufacturing footprint optimization.

_notes: Pre-Evoqua (FY21, FY22) Xylem rapportait 3 segments. WSS = segment ne mai 2023 acquisition Evoqua. Source: 10-K Xylem Inc. FY21-FY25 SEC EDGAR.
